contracts.goal: Validate the bounded Issue 9 plan-stage live fixture
scope: Publish one temporary Issue and its exact Contract in existing Milestone 1
Publish a Plan candidate and read back its exact native identities
Verify independent Agent-instance review, exact Controller approval, activation and cleanup
non_goals: No startup or design or Planner end-to-end validation
No changes to pre-existing objects or product dispatch

acceptance.statement: Verify the authorized plan-stage fixture through real native publication, exact independent Agent-instance review, Controller approval, activation, remote drift checks and confirmed cleanup.

acceptance_environment.network: Real GitHub REST through the production Gateway only; offline checks use local httptest
acceptance_environment.credentials: Controller-held existing GitHub credential; native credential separation is not claimed
acceptance_environment.fixtures: Committed exact-head Issue 9 plan-only fixture; existing control Issue 2 and Milestone 1

impact_surface: Temporary native GitHub fixture objects explicitly recorded by the runner

risks.risk: An accepted remote write has an uncertain response
risks.mitigation: Reconcile the exact operation read-only; never automatically repeat its POST
